usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan), NT$/US$ interbank closing rate
usdRate.note: Closing rate on 30 Oct 2026 (Taipei Foreign Exchange Brokerage).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: DGBAS consumer price index, September 2026 (via Trading Economics)
inflation_cpi.note: 2.73% year on year in September 2026, up from 2.05% in August; secondary source.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Central bank aim of CPI near 2%; recent CPI (DGBAS via Trading Economics)
inflation_projection.note: Taiwan CPI has stayed close to 2% over the past five years, so we plan with 2% despite the 2.7% reading in September 2026.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) discount rate (via Trading Economics)
policy_rate.note: Discount rate held at 2% at the 17 Sep 2026 meeting; the CBC discount rate page did not render.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' deposit rates, monthly history (demand savings deposit)
savings_account_rate.note: Floating rate on demand savings deposits 0.825-0.855% at the five largest banks, September 2026 (average 0.84%).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' average deposit rates (3-month fixed time deposit)

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' average deposit rates (1-year fixed time deposit)
fdr_1y_rate.note: All five banks quote 1.70% on 30 Oct 2026; 2-year 1.70-1.73%, 3-year 1.705-1.745%.

dps_rate.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' deposit rates, monthly history (3-year time savings deposit, fixed)
dps_rate.note: Average 3-year fixed rate on time savings deposits (定期儲蓄存款), the account type used for monthly installment savings (零存整付); range 1.745-1.785%, September 2026.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: The CBC weighted average deposit rate of domestic banks was not read; only five-bank posted rates were (see fdr rates).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Taiwan has no government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Treasury bills are auctioned to financial institutions; no published 91-day yield found on readable pages.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No readable published 5-year government bond yield found.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Taiwan 10-year government bond yield
tbond_10y_rate.note: 1.99% on 30 Oct 2026, about 0.72 points higher than a year earlier; secondary source.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Taiwan individual deductions
tax_bank_interest.note: No flat tax: bank deposit interest is part of consolidated income, but a special deduction of up to NT$270,000 per tax filing unit means most savers pay none; interest above that is taxed at the household's marginal rate.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists in Taiwan.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Central Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC), Deposit Insurance System overview
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Maximum coverage NT$3 million per depositor per insured institution, unchanged since 1 Jan 2011 and still shown as current on the CDIC page (read Oct 2026).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: Banking Act caps credit card revolving rates, but the law database (law.moj.gov.tw) was unreachable, so the cap is not confirmed.

equity_return_low.sourceName: TAIEX record (Trading Economics); five-bank 1-year deposit rate
equity_return_low.note: The TAIEX rose 60% in the year to 30 Oct 2026 and is concentrated in technology, so a flat decade from today's level is the low case.

equity_return_base.note: The 10-year index record is very strong, but the base is capped at the tax-free 1-year deposit rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.note: High case if technology earnings keep growing near their long-run pace.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; CBC NT$/US$ closing rate
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for a decade, and the NT dollar can strengthen against the US dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; CBC NT$/US$ closing rate
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% with no expected NT dollar depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; CBC NT$/US$ closing rate
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' average deposit rates
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case at the 3-month time deposit rate. Safe TWD rates: five-bank average fixed time deposit 1.29% (3 months) and 1.70% (1 year) on 30 Oct 2026; 10-year government bond 1.99%; deposit interest up to NT$270,000 a year per household is deductible, so most savers pay no tax on it.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' average deposit rates
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case at the 1-year time deposit rate. Safe TWD rates: five-bank average fixed time deposit 1.29% (3 months) and 1.70% (1 year) on 30 Oct 2026; 10-year government bond 1.99%; deposit interest up to NT$270,000 a year per household is deductible, so most savers pay no tax on it.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Trading Economics, Taiwan 10-year government bond yield
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case near the 10-year government bond yield. Safe TWD rates: five-bank average fixed time deposit 1.29% (3 months) and 1.70% (1 year) on 30 Oct 2026; 10-year government bond 1.99%; deposit interest up to NT$270,000 a year per household is deductible, so most savers pay no tax on it.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life insurance claim settlement ratio found on readable regulator pages.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but we found no published premium rates or credible premium guide we could read.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major hospital stay found; National Health Insurance covers most of the bill.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates found.

oop_health_share.note: Taiwan is not in World Bank or WHO health expenditure data; the Ministry of Health and Welfare national health expenditure tables were not read.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: DGBAS CPI healthcare sub-index (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_health.note: Healthcare CPI rose 0.7% in the year to September 2026 because National Health Insurance fees are regulated; we plan 1 point above general inflation for private costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: DGBAS CPI education and entertainment sub-index (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education and entertainment CPI rose 3.15% in the year to September 2026, so we plan 1 point above general inflation.

life_expectancy.note: Men 78.3, women 84.0 (2026 estimate); Taiwan is not in World Bank data; secondary source.

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age (2026); secondary source.

support_ratio.note: Taiwan is not in World Bank data; the National Development Council population projections site and UN WPP mirror pages for Taiwan were not reachable.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Bureau of Labor Insurance, Labor Insurance old-age benefits
retirement_age_default.note: Labor Insurance old-age pension age is 65 for people born in 1962 or later (so 65 for anyone born after 1975); at least 15 insured years; claim up to 5 years early at -4% a year or defer at +4% a year. Page last updated 2020, rule still in force.

retirement_age_government.note: Civil service retirement rules could not be read (Ministry of Civil Service and law database pages unreachable).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' average deposit rates
retirement_return_low.note: Low case at the 3-month time deposit rate. Safe TWD rates: five-bank average fixed time deposit 1.29% (3 months) and 1.70% (1 year) on 30 Oct 2026; 10-year government bond 1.99%; deposit interest up to NT$270,000 a year per household is deductible, so most savers pay no tax on it.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank, five major banks' average deposit rates
retirement_return_base.note: Base case at the 1-year time deposit rate (tax-free for most savers). Safe TWD rates: five-bank average fixed time deposit 1.29% (3 months) and 1.70% (1 year) on 30 Oct 2026; 10-year government bond 1.99%; deposit interest up to NT$270,000 a year per household is deductible, so most savers pay no tax on it.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Trading Economics, Taiwan 10-year government bond yield
retirement_return_high.note: High case near the 10-year government bond yield. Safe TWD rates: five-bank average fixed time deposit 1.29% (3 months) and 1.70% (1 year) on 30 Oct 2026; 10-year government bond 1.99%; deposit interest up to NT$270,000 a year per household is deductible, so most savers pay no tax on it.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of TWD deposits, bonds and equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% equity at the low case and 60% deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of TWD deposits, bonds and equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half equity at 5.7% and half deposits near 1.7%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of TWD deposits, bonds and equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% equity at the high case and 40% deposits and bonds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The Old-age Basic Guaranteed Pension (NT$4,049, BLI) is closed: only people already 65 on 1 Oct 2008 qualify, so someone planning today cannot receive it. A means-tested living allowance for low-income seniors exists, but its official page (sfaa.gov.tw) was unreachable, so no amount is given.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No open universal non-contributory pension; the Old-age Basic Guaranteed Pension only covers people aged 65 by 1 Oct 2008 (BLI). The low-income senior living allowance rules could not be read (sfaa.gov.tw unreachable).

gratuity_rule.note: Taiwan has no gratuity in the Bangladesh sense: under the Labor Pension Act employers pay at least 6% of wages a month into the worker's individual pension account (not read), and the old Labor Standards Act retirement pay only covers service before July 2005.

public_pension_scheme.note: Labor Insurance old-age pension from 65 (BLI) with at least 15 insured years and benefit of 1.55% of average insured salary per year; whether it is indexed to CPI and its tax treatment could not be confirmed from readable pages.

dps.note: Monthly installments into a time savings deposit (1-3 years).

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned to financial institutions; not sold directly to individuals.

tbond_5y.note: Mainly held by institutions; individuals can invest through bond funds or ETFs and the bond OTC market.

tbond_10y.note: Mainly held by institutions; individuals can invest through bond funds or ETFs.

equity_fund.note: Index ETFs on the TAIEX and other indices are widely held by retail investors.

gold.note: Gold bars and coins are sold by banks and jewellers; banks also offer gold passbook accounts.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

pensionScheme.name: Bureau of Labor Insurance (Labor Insurance and Labor Pension)

statistics.name: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS)
